children: Dream Finders Homes entered into Subscription Agreements with institutional investors to issue 225,000 shares of Series B Convertible Preferred Stock for $225.0 million, with a 2.5% original issue discount. Proceeds redeemed all Series A preferred and support general corporate uses, with a further 450,000 Series B shares to be sold at merger close to help fund the Beazer transaction. The preferred carries a 12% cumulative dividend, company redemption rights after year three, and post-year-six conversion features, subject to NYSE shareholder approval limits. Transfer restrictions, protective covenants tied to the credit agreement, and fundamental change rights apply.
Agreement 1: Dream Finders Homes Raises $225 Million in Series B Convertible Preferred; Up to $450 Million More at Merger Close
: Subscription Agreements for Series B Convertible Preferred Stock
: Perpetual preferred; company redemption rights after year three
: Refinance preferred stock and fund pending Beazer merger
Agreement 2: Dream Finders Homes Grants Investor Rights Including Board Observers, Standstill and ROFR
: While holders own Series B preferred (standstill: 18 months)
: Provide governance rights and protections to new investors
Agreement 3: Dream Finders Homes Agrees to Register Resale of Series B Preferred and Conversion Shares
: Until registered securities are sold or cease to be registrable
: Facilitate liquidity for investors via SEC-registered resales
Agreement 4: Dream Finders Homes Secures Voting Support From CEO for Shareholder Approval
: Through the vote on Requisite Shareholder Approval
: Increase certainty of shareholder approval for conversion shares
